item.title: Trump vows to hit Iran 'very hard' after obliterating nearly '90 percent' of regime missiles
item.summary: President Donald Trump outlines continued Iran war strategy, claims 90% of Iranian missiles destroyed and signals more strikes as tensions drive oil prices higher.

item.title: Inside the Israeli drone unit taking on Iran and Hezbollah

item.title: Hegseth scolds CNN's 'unserious' report on Iran conflict, suggests Paramount owner should overhaul network
item.summary: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth singled out CNN for its "unserious" report on the Iran conflict, suggesting its prospective new owner David Ellison will save the network.

item.title: Old Dominion University ROTC cadets disarm ISIS supporter shouting 'Allahu Akbar' during shooting: officials
item.summary: ODU shooting investigated as terrorism after Mohamed Bailor Jalloh, former ISIS supporter, killed Lt. Col. Brandon Shah before students disarmed him, FBI officials said.

item.title: Michigan synagogue security 'heroes' 'saved lives' during Temple Israel attack, governor says
item.summary: Gov. Gretchen Whitmer of Michigan declared during a press briefing on Friday that the security officers present during the attack at Temple Israel on Thursday were "heroes" who "saved lives."

item.title: New Iranian supreme leader 'likely disfigured,' Hegseth says
item.summary: War Secretary Pete Hegseth said in a Friday morning press briefing that Iranian supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei is “likely disfigured."
